picks.title: Stem Separation Moves Into the Edit: What Enhance Audio Changes for Dialogue Workflows in Premiere (Beta)
picks.excerpt: Premiere's beta Enhance Audio now separates dialogue, music and ambience stems inside the timeline, so editors can fix uneven lav/boom tracks and baked-in music without a round trip to audio post.
picks.rationale: A new Premiere beta feature: AI stem separation inside the timeline lets editors fix dialogue tracks without sending them to audio post. Editors can use it tomorrow.

picks.title: OpenAI's shelved Sora may return as AI for filmmakers
picks.excerpt: Citing The Information, OpenAI is negotiating to transfer its discontinued Sora video model to a months-old startup that builds AI video tools for filmmakers and plans to keep improving Sora.
picks.rationale: OpenAI's discontinued Sora video model may be handed to a startup that builds tools for filmmakers. A major video model could return as a production tool. This is reported news, not yet confirmed.

picks.title: [극장가] 롯데시네마서 AI 영화 3천원…87개국 출품작 엄선
picks.excerpt: Lotte Cinema is giving 18 finalist AI films from the 2026 K-AICA awards, picked from entries from 87 countries, an exclusive theatrical run at 3,000 won a ticket.
picks.rationale: A major Korean cinema chain is giving AI-made shorts a dedicated paid theatrical run. AI films are moving from festivals into regular theater distribution.

picks.title: 촬영부터 더빙까지 책상머리서 뚝딱…게임하듯 영화 찍는 시대
picks.excerpt: TapNow's 'Arena Peak Asia' Seoul round had teams make 3–8 minute AI films in 32 hours, using the platform for at least 80% of production from shooting to dubbing.
picks.rationale: A 32-hour Seoul competition had teams make short films with one AI platform covering at least 80% of production, from shooting to dubbing. It shows how far a single-tool pipeline now reaches.

picks.title: BBC's Kate Phillips On AI, YouTube & 'Blue Planet III'
picks.excerpt: At MIPCOM the BBC's content chief said the broadcaster would never 'lie to the audience' about AI use in its productions, days after the DG said he'd been sent a 'pretty good' AI-generated Doctor Who episode.
picks.rationale: At MIPCOM, the BBC's content chief committed the broadcaster to being open with audiences about AI use in its productions. This is a policy statement from a major commissioner, separate from the earlier Doctor Who remark.
